title: Lost Mary BM600 Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava blends three exotic fruit flavours into one vibrant vape. Tart Kiwi brings a bright edge, Passionfruit adds depth and tropical sweetness, and mellow Guava rounds things off with a soft, fruity smoothness. Each puff delivers a well-layered fruit medley that’s both sharp and sweet in equal measure. These pods are designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit and contain 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw with fast-acting nicotine relief. Each pod delivers up to 600 puffs depending on personal vaping style. When one pod runs out, just click in a fresh replacement to keep the flavour going.
